title: The IOL-AI Challenge: An Open Challenge towards Advancing Linguistic Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.18011v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reasoning in LLMs is overwhelmingly studied in domains that provide a model with rules: mathematics and code. Linguistic puzzles invert this: the solver must first discover the system before reasoning within it. We present the IOL-AI Challenge, an open-science competition run on the unseen problems of the International Linguistics Olympiad (IOL) 2026 Individual Contest, evaluated both automatically and, for the first time, by members of the official IOL Jury under the same rubrics applied to human contestants. The challenge drew 731 submissions from 46 teams under a strict compute budget (one T4, 30 mins). We additionally benchmark 15 unconstrained frontier and open models, with Claude Opus 4.8 earning a jury score equivalent to a gold medal, while both resource-constrained systems we submitted for jury grading scored in the range of the bottom 5% of contestants. translated_title: IOL-AI挑战：一项推进语言推理的开放竞赛
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18011v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在大型语言模型（LLM）中，推理研究主要集中在为模型提供规则的领域：数学和代码。语言谜题则反转了这一过程：求解者必须先发现系统规则，然后才能在其内部进行推理。我们提出了IOL-AI挑战，这是一项开放科学竞赛，基于2026年国际语言学奥林匹克竞赛（IOL）个人赛的未见问题展开，采用自动评估，并首次由IOL官方评审团成员按照应用于人类参赛者的相同评分标准进行评价。该挑战在严格的计算预算下（一张T4 GPU，30分钟）吸引了来自46个团队的731份提交。此外，我们基准测试了15个无约束的前沿和开放模型，其中Claude Opus 4.8获得了相当于金牌的评审分数，而我们提交给评审团评分的两个资源受限系统则落在参赛者后5%的范围内。能力并非由规模决定：140亿参数的提交表现优于某些更大模型。
tldr: 该论文介绍了IOL-AI挑战，一项基于国际语言学奥林匹克竞赛未见问题的开放竞赛，首次结合官方评审和自动评估，发现语言推理能力不依赖于模型规模，且资源受限系统表现远低于前沿模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the IOL-AI Challenge, an open competition on unseen International Linguistics Olympiad problems with official jury and automatic evaluation, revealing that linguistic reasoning capability is not determined by model scale, with resource-constrained systems scoring far below frontier models.
